model.description: R19.88.A fix: the R19.88 whenDefined gate did NOT fully fix the partial-init race — re-render still destroys+recreates items via innerHTML='' churn, re-introducing the per-item init race. FIX: stop destroy+recreate; DIFF/update existing rb-object-item DOM nodes in place (match by file UUID, update changed props, add new, remove deleted). Never innerHTML='' the container holding live custom elements (architect option-c: virtual-DOM-style reconcile preserving initialized elements). Singular-chain: ONE UseCase per Task; ONE Method per UseCase (learning #27). Architect to design the UC.
